text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mornin'! Trainer!
And then, and then!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Uuu... But I'm so sleepy~ Rice-chan and I studied for our test during the break, you see.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I memorized three whole pages of the textbook, you know? That took a lot of brainpower...

It seems Haru Urara
wasn't able to get a good rest...
